notes: Comprehensive collection of Louisiana animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Louisiana SPCA provides award-winning services in Orleans Parish. Animal Rescue New Orleans (founded 2006) is a leading no-kill shelter. Coverage spans New Orleans, Baton Rouge, Shreveport, Lafayette area, Lake Charles, Monroe, Covington, and Hammond.
